text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Awww… Even as plushies, Umamusume are the most precious of flowers. They aren't to be taken lightly.
choice_data_list: Sorry… I didn't have what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's okay! You didn't do anything wrong!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've already abandoned my worldly desires for things such as cuddling and petting, but I suppose I still have a ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to build more good karma and purify myself further to become a simp worthy of a Cutie!
